title: Floating nametags?

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
It's being looked into, apparently it's part of a hacking detection programme, but as we are not utterly sure / neither we can confirm that is the case, we're just looking into ways of removing those fake players.

Please report new bugs that may arise @ our issue tracker!
